Metadata runtime bundle

The app uses ExifTool's metadata engine through ZeroPerl's public in-memory
filesystem API. Runtime files are already built; hosting this app needs no
package manager, build step, or external service.

Provenance: dependencies.json and exiftool-build.json.
The CLI and WASM are an unchanged, checksum-verified pair from
@colorhythm/exiftool-wasm 1.0.8 (ExifTool 13.63, Perl 5.42.0).
Only the unmodified ZeroPerl adapter and CLI are bundled, not the package's
single-file metadata wrapper. The app supplies its own two-file copy operation.

To reproduce runtime.js, in this directory:
1. Expand source.zip here; it creates source\.
2. Copy zeroperl.wasm to source\zeroperl\zeroperl.wasm.
3. With esbuild 0.25.12 available, run:

esbuild runtime-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --external:node:* --loader:.wasm=file --loader:.pl=text --asset-names=[name] --outfile=runtime.js --legal-comments=inline --minify

source.zip contains the adapter's original TypeScript sources. The unchanged
upstream src/exiftool is named source\exiftool.pl for the bundler's text loader.
Rebuilding the WASM itself uses the upstream zeroperl build at the revision
recorded in dependencies.json, with the ExifTool version and source checksum
from exiftool-build.json. See THIRD-PARTY.txt for source and license locations.
